question.html:
A loudspeaker placed at point A emits a sound wave. The intensity of the wave detected at point B is W m. Point C is along the same line as A and B. The distance between A and B is m and the distance between B and C is m.

a. Show that the intensity detected at C is about W m.

   [2]

The amplitude of the sound wave emitted by the loudspeaker is reduced by %.

b. Find the new intensity that is detected at C.

   [1]

A second loudspeaker is placed at a point C.

Both loudspeakers emit sound waves of the same intensity. The intensity at point A due to the loudspeaker at point C is W m.

c. Outline what is meant by the principle of superposition of waves.

   [2]

d. Calculate the maximum possible intensity detected at point B when the two loudspeakers emit sound waves in phase.

   [2]
